messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Darrin Moore <darrin.moore@openarc.com>
Cc: contracts@openarc.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action grid: 48h commit status and traffic-light for OpenArc Pharma - Q2 close

Team, Darrin,

We are entering the 48 hour window for Q2 close. I attached an action grid (2027-04-28_action_grid_OpenArc.xlsx) that breaks the OpenArc Pharma opportunity into ownerable actions and a traffic light for commit probability. Please do the following by end of day Thursday 04/29: 

- Update your row in the action grid with explicit stage selection: Commit, At-risk, No-go.
- If At-risk or No-go, add blocker and next step.
- Confirm procurement contact and expected PO date.

Key asks for OpenArc:
- Legal redlines: Marissa, can you confirm whether SOW-v3 is acceptable or needs a redline? I linked SOW-OpenArc-v3.pdf.
- PO timing: Darrin, we need a target PO date to include in forecast. If procurement needs a template I attached OpenArc-PO-template.docx.
- Finance: Marcus, flag any billing constraints that would force us to move revenue out.

I will compile a traffic-light rollup and send a final snapshot Friday morning. If any team member needs a quick 10 minute sync, drop an availability slot into my calendar.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- 2027-04-28_action_grid_OpenArc.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 tab: action grid)
- SOW-OpenArc-v3.pdf (PDF, draft)
- OpenArc-PO-template.docx (Word, vendor PO template)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action grid: 48h commit status and traffic-light for OpenArc Pharma - Q2 close

On Wed, 28 Apr 2027 at 09:12 Naomi Feldman wrote:
> Team, Darrin,
>
> We are entering the 48 hour window for Q2 close...

Naomi, quick update from my side: sales signal is strong but legal requested a minor change to section 4 in the SOW. Marissa, can you advise if we can accept the requested language or push back to keep our standard terms?

Also Darrin told me yesterday that their CFO is out until Friday, so procurement may not be able to sign until Mon 05/03. That would push PO outside Q2. If procurement can only do a verbal commit this week, we should record as At-risk and note the verbal commit in the action grid.

I updated the action grid row under my name: CommitProbability set to At-risk and Comment=Verbal CFO approval expected next week.

Ben
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Darrin Moore <darrin.moore@openarc.com>

Cc: contracts@openarc.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Action grid: 48h commit status and traffic-light for OpenArc Pharma - Q2 close

Naomi, Ben,

Thanks for the heads up. Confirming procurement is reviewing SOW-v3 now. We had one in-house legal comment about indemnity limits that we marked in the Doc. Procurement expects to finish internal review by Friday EOD ET but the CFO is travelling and will only sign next week. I can get a procurement-confirmation email today that they intend to issue a PO once the CFO signs. Will that suffice for you to mark as CommitProbability=Commit with a procurement caveat?

I have copied contracts@openarc.com for PO processing. If you need a DocuSign link or final invoice I can route that over.

Darrin Moore
Senior Procurement Manager
OpenArc Pharma

Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: FINAL 48h snapshot: OpenArc traffic-light and forecast action items (rolling to finance)

Team, Darrin, contracts,

Closing the loop with the 48 hour snapshot for OpenArc Pharma. Summary below is pulled from the action grid (link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB3cExampleGrid). I have pushed this into the Q2 commit rollup in HubSpot.

Opportunity: OpenArc Pharma (DL-2027-1439)
- Sales owner: Ben Carter
- Current traffic-light: At-risk -> Procurement confirmation pending CFO signature
- Sales note: Verbal procurement confirmation received; procurement email confirmation expected 04/29 (received) and PO expected by 05/03 per Darrin
- Legal status: SOW-OpenArc-v3 has one indemnity redline flagged by OpenArc legal. Marissa to advise on accept or escalate.
- Finance ask: Marcus, please flag whether we can recognize revenue on verbal procurement confirmation or if PO is required for Q2 recognition. If PO required, forecast should move to Next Quarter.

Actions (owners and ETA):
1) Marissa Cole - legal decision on indemnity provision - ETA: 05/01 EOD
2) Darrin Moore / contracts@openarc.com - provide formal procurement confirmation email and route PO via DocuSign - ETA: 05/03
3) Ben Carter - capture customer verbal confirmation in HubSpot and follow up with CFO calendar hold - ETA: 04/30
4) Marcus Lin - confirm revenue recognition constraint and update finance forecast - ETA: 05/01 EOD

If any owner cannot meet ETA, flag immediately in the action grid and reply-all. For forecasting purposes I will mark this opportunity as At-risk in the committed bucket and move the pro forma revenue to pipeline until the PO is sighted.

Thanks all, excellent cross-functional execution here. I will circulate a final commit rollup once we have PO or a legal escalation.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
